summary: Re-verified Upcoming Features (roadmap) end-to-end with the TWO new requirements: (1) per-feature optional DESCRIPTION field, and (2) industrial SKIN applied to admin + user screens via SkinnedCard. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (added two new cases — test_create_with_descriptions_persists and test_update_changes_description — to confirm description field round-trips on POST/PUT and survives a fresh GET). Frontend ADMIN (mechanicltz@gmail.com): Vault/More tab top 'ROADMAP' section -> 'Admin · Manage Roadmap' loaded; created a new dated update with date 09/30/2099, title 'TEST_iter34_release', 2 features each with a TITLE and a DESCRIPTION; status pill cycled correctly On The List -> Work Started -> Completed for feature 1; after Publish the admin list rendered both features showing their descriptions beneath the title plus the colored status pill. Edit (pencil icon) opens with date, title, feature title AND description all PRE-FILLED correctly (screenshot iter34_edit_modal.png confirms 'Original description text' in the description field); changed the description, hit SAVE CHANGES, and the updated text appeared in the admin list. Frontend USER (ryan@ryan.com): /upcoming-features renders inside metal-frame SkinnedCard windows (18 skin window PNG instances detected in DOM), titles + colored status pills + descriptions all visible, releases ordered soonest-date-first (July 10, 2026 before September 30, 2099 — sort check returned True), 'Want your idea to be put on this list? Send us a Message' prompt rendered above ReportBugBadge (testID 'upcoming-feedback' visible). Admin gating: Ryan navigating to /admin/upcoming-features correctly redirected to /more. Delete via API returned 200; all TEST_ releases cleaned up — zero TEST_ rows remain. Industrial SKIN confirmed visually in every screenshot — both admin and user screens use the metal window-frame card with rivets and the dark canvas background. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_upcoming.py: _clean_features now also strips description and persists it. Empty descriptions are stored as '' (not null) which keeps the FeatureItem schema stable. Status validation still defaults invalid -> 'On The List'.

upcoming-features/index.tsx (user) + admin/upcoming-features.tsx: both use SkinnedCard, which renders the industrial 'window' PNG via TbvFrame when the active skin is industrial and falls back to BevelCard otherwise — confirmed working with 18 skin PNGs detected in the DOM under industrial.
Admin modal correctly prefills description on edit (rel.features[i].description -> draft.description) and the save payload includes the trimmed description for every feature.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ releases created during this run (TEST_iter34_release, TEST_iter34_edit_target); both deleted at end. Final GET /api/upcoming-features confirmed zero TEST_-prefixed rows remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DateField testID 'upcoming-date' accepts MM/DD/YYYY masked text (e.g. '09/30/2099'). The Alert.alert delete confirmation on React Native Web does not produce a DOM 'Delete' button — it uses window.confirm internally and any Playwright dialog handler must accept it; if testing delete via UI, accept the native dialog or fall back to DELETE /api/admin/upcoming-features/{id}. Admin auth token can be read from localStorage (first key whose value starts with 'eyJ') for direct API cleanup. Two new backend tests assert description persistence on both create and update paths.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Description field persists end-to-end on POST + PUT, prefills correctly on edit, and renders on both admin and user screens. Industrial skin applied via SkinnedCard renders the metal window-frame PNG on both screens with the app canvas background.
